item.title: For teens with substance abuse disorders, a new school offers hope and a place to learn
item.description: At the Harbor Hope Center in Chesapeake, students don't just learning about literature and arithmetic. They're learning how to recover from drug and alcohol dependency.

item.title: Motorcycle crash on Terminal Boulevard causes 1 death
item.description: A 24-year-old motorcyclist died from a crash with a 4-door sedan on Terminal Boulevard on Saturday evening, Norfolk police said.

item.title: ODU holds on to win baseball series finale vs. UConn
item.description: Meanwhile, Virginia Tech upended third-ranked Georgia Tech after dropping the series' first two games.

item.title: Boston University stuns top-seeded Navy in Patriot League semifinal
item.description: Navy is highly unlikely to gain an NCAA at-large bid but well could play in another postseason tournament. Boston University will play at No. 2 seed Lehigh in the championship game Wednesday. Meanwhile, ninth-seeded Campbell bounced top-seeded UNC Wilmington in a CAA quarterfinal.

item.title: No. 2 Virginia Wesleyan goes to 8-0 in softball
item.description: Against Muhlenberg, Samantha Deitsch, Taylor Mcqueen and Alison Pollack hit home runs. Versus Greensboro, Hannah Hearl and Emma Adams combined for a one-hitter.

item.title: Duke outlasts Louisville in OT for ACC women’s title
item.description: Also, Rhode Island edged George Mason in the Richmond area for the Atlantic 10 championship, and James Madison romped to Monday's Sun Belt title game.

item.title: Motorcyclist suffers life-threatening injuries from crash on Kempsville Road
item.description: A motorcyclist has life-threatening injuries after a crash with another vehicle on Sunday afternoon on Kempsville Road.

item.title: Pentagon announces 7th U.S. death in war with Iran
item.description: For the United States, the grim toll in the first week of the war signaled that Iran was more prepared for war than the Trump administration anticipated, U.S. military officials said.

item.title: U.S. Tomahawk missile hit naval base beside Iranian school, video shows
item.description: A newly released video adds to the evidence that a U.S. missile likely hit an Iranian elementary school where 175 people, many of them children, were reported killed.

item.title: Hofstra surges early, knocks William & Mary out of CAA quarterfinals
item.description: The Tribe dropped to 20-12, and W&M's albatross of never making the NCAA Tournament remains.
